entries.text: Morning update (6 AM CT): BTC lost $82.5K and trades ~$82.0K (24h $81.6K-$84.8K) as a global risk-off move hit crypto: Nasdaq futures fell on Tesla and Lam Research outlooks, China's CSI 300 entered a bear market, Brent topped $112, and ~$431M was liquidated in 24h (CoinDesk/CoinGlass). Slate: no fills, stops or targets since the last update. BTC T007 (long from 82,300, stop 80,800), ZBCN T004 and XDC T006 (spot) stay open; the XLM T003 short never got its rally and is left to expire Oct 23. No new ideas: most alts are oversold on the 1h and sitting just above their October floors, so shorts have no room and longs fight the daily trend. Watchlist news: XRPL's fixCleanup3_4_0 fix slipped to Nov 4 after a validator-support dip; Hedera launched its Network MCP on testnet; SBI's XDC venture signed a yen-stablecoin MOU with Shinhan Card. Policy: the banking industry pushed back on the OCC's GENIUS Act rule on stablecoin rewards.
